title: Saturday in Alfama: custard tarts, trams and two viewpoints
subtitle: An easy walk with long stops, ending where the sunset is best. Leave at 9:30, home by 16:00.
wind: A light breeze from the ocean after 14:00: take a jumper for the viewpoints.

stops.name: Manteigaria, Chiado
stops.description: Custard tarts straight from the oven, eaten standing at the counter.
stops.why: The first batch comes out at 8:00: by 9:30 there’s no queue yet.

stops.name: Miradouro da Senhora do Monte
stops.description: The highest viewpoint in the old town, with the castle and the river in one look.
stops.why: Quieter than the famous ones, and the morning light is behind you.

stops.name: Alfama and the Sé
stops.description: Stairs, laundry lines and tiled walls down to the 12th-century cathedral.
stops.why: Saturday mornings smell of grilled sardines from the open doors.

stops.name: A small tasca on Rua dos Remédios
stops.walk: up the steps to the viewpoint, 12 min
stops.description: Grilled fish of the day, a salad and house wine, at a table on the street.
stops.why: Locals eat here: the menu is on a board and changes daily.

stops.name: Miradouro de Santa Luzia
stops.description: Tiles, bougainvillea and the river under a pergola.
stops.why: Take the bench on the left: the best light hits the rooftops at 15:30.

photos.caption: Senhora do Monte in the morning
